benchmark_plan: Same binary preloaded prior QAT v1 vs selected v2;163 legal transitions,500000 iterations,8 rounds,alternating model/workload order; no strength claim
calibration_limitation: Initializer already saw all original train positions; ranking is in-sample calibration
format: New v2 fixed point768x16; input/bias quantized at S, clip127*S, output quantized at8, denominator8*S; v1 compatibility preserved
goal: Retain learned input-layer changes in deployed fixed-point weights; separate rescaling-only changes from training changes
ranking: Final serialized integer train MAE, then train RMSE, then fixed plan index, ascending
references: Each S has an untrained same-scale re-quantized original float checkpoint; record changed input integers relative to this reference and ablation reverting trained inputs only
required_before_new_holdout: Selected trained model has input integer changes beyond same-scale initializer; all core tests/parity pass
selection_data: Original1498 train positions only; no old validation/old QAT holdout labels or new holdout read
